profile_text.body:
Arize AI is a company focused on observability, evaluation, and improvement tooling for AI systems, particularly large language model applications and AI agents. The company describes its platform as supporting agent observability, tracing, evaluation, and experimentation, and positions it for use cases including chatbots, retrieval-augmented generation systems, copilots, and agents. Arize states it integrates with more than 40 models, frameworks, and AI tools, including OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Amazon Bedrock, LangGraph, LangChain, LlamaIndex, CrewAI, the OpenAI Agents SDK, and DSPy.

The company offers two principal products. Arize Phoenix is described as a source-available, self-hostable platform for AI observability and evaluation, built on the OpenInference and OpenTelemetry open standards, covering tracing, evaluations, RAG metrics, and embedding drift. Arize AX is the company's managed platform built on the same open standards, adding managed infrastructure, advanced agent observability, online evaluations, and continual improvement workflows for production AI systems. The company also describes a product called Alyx, which it characterizes as an AI engineering assistant that runs evaluations, debugs issues, and improves agents autonomously.

The held facts show Arize AI tracked under the AI Governance and Risk Management Platforms category, with both the main Arize AI platform and Arize Phoenix registered as distinct products. No litigation, SEC filings, patents, or MCP server registrations are recorded for the company.
